inputs.text: This is yet another leftist assault on the foundations of our society, chipping away at the personal responsibility and cultural continuity that have long upheld order in our communities. In New York, as part of the 2026 State of the State agenda, the proposed legislation would require guns sold there to be designed so they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns and would establish criminal penalties. This is a deliberate effort to restrict the rights of law-abiding citizens and manufacturers under the pretext of stopping illegal modifications. Instead of upholding traditional values by enforcing accountability on those who break the law, they are going after the tools Americans have relied on for generations to defend their families and maintain security. We must reject these attacks on our national heritage and the family's sacred duty to protect itself.
